// diagnostic E2814

Jet.WebhookKeyNotSigningKey

`key: "{key}"` names no `#App.SigningKey` method of `{service}`.

What

`key: "{key}"` names no `#App.SigningKey` method of `{service}`.

Why

A webhook runs a delivery only when its signature matches the key that the service's signing-key method gives, so `key:` must name such a method.

Fix

Mark the method `{key}` names `#App.SigningKey`, or name one that it marks.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.WebhookKeyNotSigningKey: Tests/UI/web_app_webhook_key_not_signing_key.stderr.
